en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1253 - Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
about the verse of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
"Then when the prayer is ended, disperse in the land and seek Allah’s (swt) bounty" (Surah Al-Jumu'ah 62:10).
Imam (as) said: "The prayer is on the day of Jumu’ah, and the dispersal is on the day of Saturday."
